coordinate_system: Y-up, -Z forward; one exported unit is one meter

asset_contract.title: Rotor mast
asset_contract.summary: A banded iron mast on a wooden step carrying two four-bladed canvas lift rotors on a vertical axis, a brass finial and two red pennants streaming aft. Ship part hull.rotor_mast (node part).
asset_contract.placement: Pivot at the centre of the origin block's floor: the frame node the mast stands on (part pivot offset zero). Height 7.85 m.

nodes.name: RotorMast_Mast
nodes.role: Static: step, pole, bands, gear housings, finial and both pennants (pennants along -Z, aft).

nodes.name: RotorLow
nodes.role: Moving part. Pivot on its hub at 3.6 m; spins about local Y. 2.1 m across.

nodes.name: RotorHigh
nodes.role: Moving part. Pivot on its hub at 6.35 m; spins about local Y. 4.8 m across.

asset_contract.materials: RotorMast_Iron, RotorMast_Brass, RotorMast_Wood, RotorMast_Canvas, RotorMast_Pennant; ShipDesignsAssetBuilder swaps each for the shared ship material (M_ShipIron, M_ShipEngine, M_ShipHull, M_ShipCanvas, M_ShipPennant).
asset_contract.footprint_blocks: Pole (0, 0..7, 0); low rotor layer y 3, x and z -1..1; high rotor layer y 6, x and z -2..2; pennants (0, 4, -1) and (0, 7, -1).
asset_contract.collision: One box round the pole on the prefab (0.4 x 7.8 x 0.4 m). Rotors and pennants are not solid.
asset_contract.movable_parts: RotorLow and RotorHigh are static for now; spin them about local Y for a lift effect.
